title: Buffer write at a suffix boundary
statement: For any Boolean words $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{bs}$ and bits $\mathrm{old}$ and $\mathrm{new}$, overwriting cell $|\mathrm{pre}|$ of the buffer tape containing $\mathrm{pre}\,\mathrm{old}\,\mathrm{bs}$ with $\mathrm{new}$ gives the buffer tape containing $\mathrm{pre}\,\mathrm{new}\,\mathrm{bs}$.
replaced: For all binary words $p$ and $s$ and all bits $b, b'$, overwriting cell $|p|$ of the buffer tape holding $p\,b\,s$ with the bit $b'$ yields exactly the buffer tape holding $p\,b'\,s$.
